title: TopBrain expanded vessel references

links.label: TopBrain release used in the resumed screen

summary: Expanded cerebrovascular labels used in an initial reference audit and a resumed five-scan development screen.
sample_unit: One source angiographic case, with versioned vessel-label volumes
reference_note: Five TopBrain component predictions completed after checkpoint recovery. These were public training scans selected with reference information, not held-out coding-agent trials. The earlier 244-voxel dispute and the later one-background-voxel calibration remain reference questions; no hard case was admitted.

sample_sets.label: Initial matched reference audit
sample_sets.note: Initial retrospective reference comparison of three matched MRA cases, before checkpoint recovery. The later five-scan screen is documented separately below.

sample_sets.label: Acquired reference-label collection
sample_sets.note: One hundred retained label volumes cover fifty CT/MRA case identities across v1 and v2 label schemes. This is a label inventory, not one hundred acquired images or predictions.

sample_sets.label: Resumed development screen
sample_sets.note: Five full MRA component predictions completed after model recovery. Cases 006 and 011 were additionally acquired for reference-identified third-A2/A3 anatomy; training overlap and reference-assisted selection exclude held-out claims. No brain coding-agent trial was run.

documentation_gaps: Anatomical reference disputes remain unresolved; the five-scan development screen does not establish held-out performance.
version_note: TopBrain data release Batches1n2nTA36_081726. The initial BR-033 checkpoint access failure was resolved in the separately retained resumption receipt; one official ResEncM component produced five predictions, not the three-model ensemble.
terms_note: Source-specific terms in retained receipts; recheck before reuse or redistribution.

zh-CN.title: TopBrain 扩展血管参考
zh-CN.summary: 扩展脑血管标签用于初始参考审查及恢复后的五例开发筛查。
zh-CN.sample_unit: 一例来源血管造影病例及不同版本的血管标签体数据
zh-CN.image_description: 匹配的 TopCoW／TopBrain MRA 病例。
zh-CN.reference_note: 检查点恢复后完成了五例 TopBrain 单组件预测。它们是借助参考选取的公开训练扫描，不是留出集编码智能体试验。较早的 244 体素争议及后来一个背景体素的校准仍属参考问题；没有纳入合格的困难病例。
zh-CN.version_note: TopBrain 数据版 Batches1n2nTA36_081726。BR-033 初期无法访问检查点的问题在另存的恢复收据中解决；一次官方 ResEncM 组件完成五例预测，并非三模型集成。
zh-CN.terms_note: 保留收据中记录的具体来源条款；复用或再分发前须重新核查。
documentation_gaps: 解剖参考争议未解决；五例开发筛查不证明留出集表现。
sample_set_notes: 检查点恢复前，对三例匹配 MRA 做回顾性参考比较；后续五例筛查另行记录。
保留 100 个标签体数据，对应 50 个 CT／MRA 病例身份的 v1／v2 标签方案。这是标签清单，不是 100 张已获取图像或预测。
模型恢复后完成五例完整 MRA 的单组件预测。006 和 011 另因参考中第三段 A2/A3 解剖而获取；训练集重叠及借助参考选样排除了留出集主张。没有运行脑血管编码智能体试验。
zh-CN.snapshot_summary: 原生图像及可主动揭示的来源标注。
zh-CN.snapshot_reference_note: 金色将非零血管类别合并为前景，便于解剖概览。扩展来源标签是参考标注，不是已完成模型输出。
snapshot_captions: 检查来源参考后，在各正交轴上选取参考前景面积最大的切面。规范 RAS 视图保留体素间距；未显示预测。
相同参考选定切面上的扩展来源血管标签，金色仅为合并的非零前景；不是模型输出。
